Ana: Quick heads-up — need a compact rebut pack and a webinar blurb for next Wed. Focus: competitive messaging vs cloud AI endpoints and infra vendors. Can we do a 20-min sync and a 1-pager after?

Liam: yup. 20-min works. propose slot at 10:30 PST. goal: 3 surface soundbites + 3 tech-level hooks. :thumbsup:

Sophia: I can draft the benchmark narrative. thinking: 'Serving-first performance — consistent latency, lower unit cost, predictable rollouts' Need a crisp stat or two. Can we use our internal 3-model perf matrix?

Mike: for objection handlers: short Q/A snips. e.g.
- Q: Why not cloud provider endpoints?
- A: Cloud endpoints are easy but opaque — Redwood gives predictable unit economics + routing and fallbacks that keep apps online under contention.

Jamie: also need inbound routing notes for SDRs — how to route customers who ask about on-prem vs hosted. Short flow: Hosted sales → self-serve trial; Dedicated interest → AE; Private/regulatory → Solutions Eng + Partner.

Liam: sounds good. for soundbites i suggest three tiers:
1) Executive: 'Redwood makes inference predictable — lower costs, fewer surprises.'
2) Platform eng: 'Same API, across hosted/dedicated/private with transparent latency SLOs.'
3) Infra buyer: 'Reserved capacity + SLA-backed latency for production LLMs.'

Sophia: dropping a quick draft for the webinar blurb here: 
```
Webinar: Serving-first inference for production LLMs
Join Redwood engineers to see side-by-side latency & cost tradeoffs between managed cloud endpoints and serving-focused platforms. We’ll demo routing, canary rollouts, and private deployments.
Takeaways:
- How to reduce per-token cost with batching & KV caching
- When to choose reserved capacity vs burst-hosted paths
- Real-world rollback & fallback patterns
```

Mike: love the takeaways. For the rebut pack I'll paste a few short rebut lines (one-liners):
- 'Managed cloud endpoints hide burst costs — we give unit-cost predictability.'
- 'Open-source runtimes need ops; Redwood gives a runtime + orchestration + routing.'
- 'Vendor lock? You can pin model versions and rollback across any deployment.'

Ana: These are great. Two asks before we sync: 1) Sophia — pull the 3-model perf table and give 1-2 headline stats (latency median and cost delta). 2) Jamie — write the SDR routing bullets as 2-3 lines we can paste into the playbook.

Jamie: on it. will add routing bullets + 1-liner qualifying questions.

Sophia: grabbing numbers now, will drop in #docs once validated.

marketing-bot: Created doc skeleton: /docs/marketing/competitive-rebutpack-1717214321.md (draft) — Ana please assign reviewers. :robot_face:

Ana: assigning Liam + Mike to review. Plan: quick sync 10:30 PST, finalize 1-pager and upload to playbook by EOD. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
